coaching.headline: Revenant's carry and an allied objective sweep, answered by a single enemy Fangtooth, won the game more than any lane did.

flags.text: Revenant took 19 kills for one death, six each on Kaelen and Drongo, and razed the fucking Core.
Bayle took both Shapers, Orb Prime and two Fangtooths; Revenant added Primal Fangtooth.
Lt. Belica's three kills on other lanes each preceded an allied prize, the last one the Core.
Bayle ate 10 shitty deaths, two to Sevarog outside any detected fight, and trailed Kaelen in gold.

focus.title: Cash every window, cover the jungle
focus.action: Cash every Shaper and won window into the nearest structure, and before Bayle starts a jungle fight, confirm Kaelen's and Sevarog's locations so the team can follow.

30.call: Separate plays on mid, duo and offlane went 5-1, the mid inner fell inside the window, and the offlane inner plus two inhibitors came next. Picks cashed in full; repeat that standard.

13.2.call: Bayle took Fangtooth, then the window went 3-2 as Revenant finished Zinx and Drongo. With both enemy duo players dead after a Fangtooth, push the duo outer before the respawn.

27.6.call: Revenant razed the enemy duo outer, then killed Zinx, Drongo and Kaelen before Bayle took Fangtooth and the first Shaper. Tower, picks, pit is the order to repeat.

38.7.call: Lt. Belica killed Kaelen, Bayle razed the mid inhibitor and killed Drongo and Zinx, and Revenant took the Core. After three quick kills late, go for the Core.

705dddb4-84d6-47df-9f18-92678114fa30: Hero damage ran 1299 per minute against an own average of 598, second in total damage only to Revenant. When Revenant commits, land Thorns on the same target.
Razed the enemy offlane inner and inhibitor and absorbed 75231 damage, the most of any ally. When the enemy groups on another lane, siege the offlane the same way.
7d9421db-8441-4c62-bb7a-325b6a1fca01: Ten deaths, 91% over an own average, including four to Kaelen. Next time Kaelen engages, step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root.
Objective damage of 26772, second only to Revenant in the game, plus 101 enemy-jungle minions and the mid inhibitor raze. While Kaelen shows on another lane, keep invading.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Hero damage 1192 per minute against an own average of 607, and 426 minions, the most in the game. While mid is quiet, keep that farm pace between rotations.
Two structure razes, the enemy mid inner and duo inhibitor, plus 13 wards, tied with Revenant for the allied high. Before shoving mid, keep a ward on each river entrance.
Kaelen, the enemy's top killer, scored two of four deaths. When Kaelen channels Frostfall, move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm.
2d0ccc54-9b41-4e00-92d9-12e6d00a8fa5: Led all ten players with 33015 objective damage and razed the enemy duo outer and duo inner. Keep that siege output without trading away the one-death discipline.
Four kills on other lanes, two answering an Adele death on the offlane, and no home structure lost on any trip. Once the duo outer falls, keep taking those trips.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eleven wards against an own average of 6.3, and 15 assists, more than any other player. Before each Fangtooth, spend wards on the pit approaches.
One death all game while mitigating 79706 damage, behind only Sevarog, and healing 13949. When Drongo commits on the duo lane, peel for Revenant first.

matchup: Sevarog was the lane opponent, killed this offlaner twice, and finished with the game's highest mitigation.
Sevarog's Subjugate stuns and Phantom Rush fears in an area; wait both out before engaging.
build: Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies harder each second on the same target, suited to long brawls.
Rapture adds on-hit damage to basic attacks at close range, plus omnivamp.
Fist Of Razuul, finished last, empowers a basic attack and heals from the bonus; earlier fights lacked Fist Of Razuul.
eternal: Krix adds max health by level; Voracity heals and pays gold on unit kills, Cannibalism adds health on takedowns.
Krix and Nihil are a toss-up in this offlane field; Voracity with Feeding Frenzy is the best Krix pair.
augment: Seeds of Dominion spawns a Thornbush under the Imperial Lash target that slows and deals true damage to enemies moving inside.
Tyrant of Thorns clearly leads this offlane augment field; Seeds of Dominion ranks second.
crest: Nyr Warboots' active grants decaying movement speed and regenerates max health briefly.
Magical armor came only from Nyr Warboots and the Aegis Of Agawar passive, thin cover against three magical enemy heroes.
Saphir's Mantle and Nyr Warboots are a toss-up in this offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: The suggested core is Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Forticus at 61.2% over 85 games; only Fire Blossom was built.
Tyrant of Thorns over Seeds of Dominion is the field-backed swap: stronger Crown of Thorns, a shorter Royal Flourish cooldown, no Mesmerize.

matchup: Kaelen led the head-to-head four kills to two, and 19212 gold to 17225.
Kaelen's Rimefang stuns while Winter's Pursuit and Frostfall root; Frostfall channels before the leap.
Sevarog killed this jungler three times, twice outside any detected fight.
build: Manta Scythe, Ashbringer and Onixian Quiver are the full most-played core.
Onixian Quiver on a melee hero raises crit chance and adds mitigation as health drops, instead of extra projectiles.
Imperator, finished last, makes crits hit harder; earlier fights lacked Imperator.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack, raising damage dealt to and cutting damage taken from that hero.
Lotus leans first in this jungle field; Thraex ranks last of the ranked Eternals.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity, as run, is the best Thraex pair.
augment: Frenzied Fighter keeps Berserk on with no cooldown while below the health threshold.
Frenzied Fighter leans first in this jungle augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active adds attack speed, omnivamp and empowered on-hit damage briefly.
Ortus and Iceskorn Talons lead a toss-up in this jungle field; Eviscerator ranks behind both.
improvement: The suggested core went complete, but into Kaelen that core ran 38.9% over 36 games.
Lotus for Thraex is the field lean: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the marked-target bonus.
If Kaelen's roots keep landing, Salvation adds tenacity and a low-health shield.

matchup: Gideon was the lane opponent: one kill on this midlaner, two deaths to this midlaner.
Gideon's Black Hole pulls and the Cosmic Power tether roots after a delay.
build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings, two of the suggested three, were the first and third buys.
Tainted Scepter cuts the target's healing briefly on magical damage, useful into Zinx, the enemy's only healer.
Overseer, finished last, adds ultimate damage and healing from ultimate hits; earlier fights lacked Overseer.
eternal: Vesh turns part of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Lotus leans first in this midlane field and Vesh ranks near the bottom.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Mind Rot trails.
augment: Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb hit isolated targets harder.
Combat Veteran clearly leads this midlane augment field; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Soulbearer leans first in this midlane field, ahead of Epoch, the most played crest.
improvement: The suggested core adds Oblivion Crown to Combustion and Wraith Leggings: 57.9% over 240 games.
Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs is the field-backed swap: movement speed and passive experience instead of isolated-target Void Bomb damage.
Soulbearer for Epoch trades Stasis for a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.

matchup: Steel and this carry faced Drongo and Zinx; Drongo scored the only death on this carry.
Zinx, the enemy's only healer, fell four times to this carry.
Drongo's Gag Grenade silences, the duo-lane crowd control to dodge before trading.
build: Vanquisher, Terminus and Imperator are the full winning core.
Terminus turns overheal from lifesteal into a shield.
Nuclear Rounds, finished last, raises ability damage by crit chance; earlier fights lacked Nuclear Rounds.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third straight basic attack on one hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Lotus leans first in this carry field; Vermis ranks last of the ranked Eternals.
Serration with Melting Point, as run, is the best Vermis pair.
augment: Hellfire Blast makes the fourth Hellfire Rounds shot hit harder and ignore some bonus physical armor.
Quickdraw and Spectral Bounty lead a toss-up in this carry field; Hellfire Blast, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Exodus clearly leads this carry crest field; Liberator ranks behind Ortus and Pacifier.
improvement: The full suggested core went complete; into Drongo that core ran 55% over 318 games, so no item change is proven.
Exodus over Liberator is the field-backed crest swap: a knockback grenade that makes launched heroes take more damage, giving up the cleanse.
Quickdraw over Hellfire Blast is the top toss-up pick: faster reloads instead of the armor-ignoring fourth shot.

matchup: Zinx was the opposing support: no kills, eight assists, and the game's most wards.
Zinx's Ricochet stuns the first hero hit, then bounces with shorter stuns.
The lone death came to Drongo, inside the fight before the allied duo outer fell.
build: Dynamo amplifies damage on immobilized enemies, so every Shield Bash or Shield Slam stun boosts allied follow-up.
Tainted Bastion cuts the healing of anyone dealing magical damage to the wearer.
Frostguard, finished last, cuts the attack speed of enemies whose basic attacks land; earlier fights lacked Frostguard.
eternal: Krix adds max health by level; Regenerative Tissue heals after a break from hero damage, Cannibalism adds health on takedowns.
Knell leans first in this support field; Krix sits mid-pack.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism, as run, is the best Krix pair.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, scaled by both armors.
Heavy Metal and Adaptive Force are a toss-up in this support field. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's active shields the wearer and nearby heroes, with tenacity while the shield holds; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Leafsong leans first in this support field; Sanctification, the most played, ranks below Leafsong.
improvement: Fire Blossom, Forticus and Tainted Guard won 63.9% over 155 games as the suggested core; none of the three was built.
Leafsong for Sanctification is the field lean: team movement speed and slow immunity instead of the shield and tenacity.
Knell for Krix is the field lean: armor shred on hits instead of bonus max health.

threats: Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Adele, Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
ourKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
ourKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
ourKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
ourKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
ourKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
ourKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
ourKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush to fly through and fear enemies, Subjugate to chain them in place, Siphon to steal max health, then Colossal Blow to knock them back.
enemyKits.winCondition: Farm Souls with ability last hits to reach his tiers, then lock fights with fear and Subjugate while Siphon makes him tankier.
enemyKits.passive: Reaper of Souls: ability kills give Souls for bonus health, with tiers adding omnivamp, a magical armor shred aura, stronger Siphon and damage reflect.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that turns his fear and Subjugate lockdown into kills.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not walk out of Subjugate while chained, since leaving stuns you; wait it out. Contest his last hits early to slow his Souls, and position so Colossal Blow cannot knock you into his team.

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
enemyKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

checks.text: Matched or beat their tank heroes in the draft (2 v 2).
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Steel can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,229 hero damage a minute, more than 93% of Kaelen jungle players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Onixian Quiver, Nuclear Rounds.
Frostfall at top rank: 90s base, about 75s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Nuclear Rounds 20.
Kaelen dealt 49,158 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +170 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10, Viper 8; against Bayle (level 17 estimated: about 115 physical armor, 97 after penetration) and Lt. Belica (level 17 estimated: about 115 physical armor, 97 after penetration) that is about 9% and 9% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Viper (item): Against Eroded Heroes: Deal 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage.
Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Equinox: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 350-750 Shield for 4s. Shield size increases with Level.; 17,628 healing recorded.
Toughness: +20% tenacity; took 64,142 damage, mitigated 41,115, died 12 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Onixian Quiver, Viper.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Equinox, Onixian Quiver, Viper. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Onixian Quiver.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Kaelen killed built physical armor (Adele). Anti-heal on Lt. Belica, Steel. We killed Kaelen 12 times.
Copy it? Too few Kaelen jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

evidence: Hero damage per minute 1299 vs their Adele norm 598.

19/1/3, 55936 hero damage, the most in the game.

bullets: Onixian Quiver adds 25% critical strike chance on melee heroes, and Nuclear Rounds turns critical strike chance into extra ability damage for Rimefang, Razorstorm and Winter's Pursuit.
Marrow healed Kaelen from hero damage dealt, more at low health, less on area hits; Taste of Iron briefly raised damage after Frostbite ticks hurt a hero.
Roses paid growing gold per takedown up to a cap, and each hero kill boosted Marrow's healing for a short window.
Fire Blossom burned enemies near Sevarog, ramping up to 40% while Heatwave kept hitting; Subjugate chained targets to the zone for 2s, inside burn range with Sevarog close.
Forticus gave a shield on taking hero damage, with a cooldown, plus growing health and speed in hero fights; Tainted Guard cut attackers' healing on basic attacks taken.
Krix raised Sevarog's maximum health and size; Voracity healed and paid gold per unit killed; Cannibalism added permanent maximum health per takedown, beside Siphon's temporary health steal.
Overlord splashed damage around basic attack targets, Rapture added on-hit damage up close, and each hit kept Thorns on enemy heroes, so allies dealt 5% bonus true damage.
Fire Blossom burned nearby enemies each second, and Fist of Razuul stacked while Adele dealt or took damage, empowering the next basic attack after 4 stacks.
Krix raised Adele's maximum health and size, pairing with Iron Rose's damage reduction; Voracity healed and paid gold per unit killed; Cannibalism added permanent health per takedown.
Fate's final round always critically strikes, and Imperator made critical strikes deal 30% more, so each reload ended on a big hit, plus Hellfire Rounds' missing-health bonus.
With Vermis, every third straight Fate shot landed quickly on the same hero dealt max-health damage, plus missing-health damage from Serration; Melting Point added damage against high-armor targets.
Nuclear Rounds turned critical strike chance into extra ability damage for Obliterate and Scar; Lightning Hawk built Momentum from moving or attacking into an empowered, slowing basic attack.

coachLean.headline: Revenant's 19 kills on one death and 29 river buffs to 5 carried the win through Bayle's 10 deaths and four lost towers.

flags.text: Revenant went 19/1/3 with 55,936 hero damage and 33,015 objective damage, then destroyed the Core.
The team took 29 river buffs to 5, the Shaper twice, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth.
Three mid-game fights ended even while the enemy took four towers, including the offlane inner.
Bayle died 10 times, 91% above the usual on the hero, with 4 of those deaths to Kaelen.

focus.action: Open fights with Steel's Shield Slam, chain Seismic Assault then Royal Flourish, and keep the jungler out until Kaelen spends Frostfall.

705dddb4-84d6-47df-9f18-92678114fa30: Carried the offlane damage: 1,299 hero damage a minute against a usual 598, with only 3 deaths.
Sevarog scored 2 of 3 deaths; wait out Subjugate and Phantom Rush, then land Royal Flourish as Seismic Assault ends.
7d9421db-8441-4c62-bb7a-325b6a1fca01: Objective damage reached 26,772, second on the team; next game, enter fights behind Steel's Shield Slam, not ahead of it.
Against Kaelen, step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root, and leave the Rimestorm when Frostfall lands.
Placed 2 wards against a usual 5.6; ward the river entrances on the Kaelen side before contesting Fangtooth next game.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Mid damage nearly doubled the norm: 1,192 a minute against 607, with 6/4/12 and 47% kill participation.
Killed Drongo on the duo lane before mid opened, and the team took Fangtooth next; repeat that trip next game.
Kaelen scored 2 of 4 deaths: move out of the center of the Frostfall landing and leave the Rimestorm.
2d0ccc54-9b41-4e00-92d9-12e6d00a8fa5: Lone death came in a fight just before two allied outer towers fell; next game, back off even tower fights once the support goes down.
Finished the Core with 33,015 objective damage; next game, open picks with Scar's root so Neural Disruptor follows for the kill.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Anchored the front: 79,706 mitigated, 47% kill participation and 15 assists with a single death.
Ran the vision with 11 wards placed and 4 cleared, behind the 21 Zinx placed; push toward that count next game.

buildCall.705dddb4-84d6-47df-9f18-92678114fa30: Into Sevarog, 51.3% over 119 games: swap Raiment of Renewal for Tainted Guard, anti-heal against Sevarog's 13,088 healing.
buildCall.7d9421db-8441-4c62-bb7a-325b6a1fca01: Ran the most played core into Kaelen, 38.9% in 36 games; Salvation for tenacity was NOT built: add Salvation fourth, before Imperator.
buildCall.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Combustion and Wraith Leggings follow the 52.6% core into Gideon; buy Noxia second instead of Megacosm, keeping Tainted Scepter for Kaelen's healing.
buildCall.2d0ccc54-9b41-4e00-92d9-12e6d00a8fa5: Into Drongo, the 55% Vanquisher > Terminus > Imperator core was all built; buy Terminus second, ahead of Lightning Hawk.
buildCall.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Best core is Fire Blossom > Forticus > Tainted Guard, 63.9% in 155 games; buy Forticus second in place of Dynamo.
